### Surface Snapshot

- Subsystems: 4
- Production files: 20
- Persistent/external boundaries: 2

The subsystems are prompt templates, workflow skills, harness orchestrator agent files, and user documentation. The production-file count is the Files Touched table's non-test rows (the new template and skill count as files; the changelog counts). The two boundaries are the Git-tracked brief/snapshot artifacts and the GitHub issue/PR/comment surface reached through `gh`. No new abstraction, schema, database table, or lock is introduced; adding any of those requires revising this plan first.

findings.title: Validate source discovery and inspect existing linked PRs
findings.failure: Duplicate implementation or incorrect source/plan association, including interpreting quoted hostile source markers as workflow identity.
findings.lowestCostCorrection: Define gh queries for linked PRs plus marker/branch matches; validate literal canonical first-line brief markers and plan associations at each ref; pin original source commit/blob references for comparison and review; preserve snapshots on incomplete continuation. Add corresponding command/fixture/manual cases without a new index.

findings.title: Make refresh and closure reconciliation compatible with sealed runs
findings.failure: Normal retries become permanently blocked or source refresh writes into sealed workflow history.
findings.lowestCostCorrection: Separate delegated pre-seal source revisions from read-only post-seal refresh. Reconcile marked prior closure and external closure before generic state-drift handling; detect reopening against a delivery receipt. Add repeat-resume, externally-closed, reopened, and read-only refresh cases.

findings.title: Use authoritative accepted delivery endpoints and normal completion evidence
findings.failure: Unreviewed or divergent work can be attested as delivered, while valid ordinary completion and squash delivery can be rejected.
findings.lowestCostCorrection: Specify exact accepted endpoint and range extraction from durable runtime contexts, observations, correction/completion evidence, and sealed records; restrict legacy extraction to unbound compatibility. Distinguish overall delivery from latest phase range, check ancestry and configured evidence-path allowances, preserve authorized final corrections, and verify mutable PR claims against committed evidence. Add executable Git/protocol fixtures where seams exist.

findings.title: Separate plan and implementation finding classes in all modes
findings.failure: Issue-acceptance findings fail validation or enter the wrong review and amendment route.
findings.lowestCostCorrection: Qualify the design and initial/continued clauses: applicable plan review uses plan classes; bound implementation review uses implementation_defect linked to approved W IDs or plan_defect under source-of-correction precedence; off/unbound review retains v1 output. Preserve existing evidence requirements and add mode/domain contract assertions.

findings.title: Define unauthorized publication and failed synchronization exits
findings.failure: Premature issue closure, false success after failed remote writes, duplicate comments on retry, or unusable publication handoff.
findings.lowestCostCorrection: Specify no-authorization and failed-push/PR handoffs. Require confirmed marked evidence publication before close; failed or unknown comment/close results return delivered_sync_pending with the exact missing operation and resume steps. Re-read and reuse remote objects on retries; add denied authorization and remote-write failure cases.

baselineAssessment.reason: Independent assessment of bounded intake/provenance, compact and coverage prompt integration, multi-run delivery instructions, and effective multi-mode installation/override verification. Exact delivery identity and retry contracts make this cross-cutting asset work, but no new workflow engine, database, provider, or command family is necessary.
